records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue increased by $22.7 million and $67.7 million during the three and nine months ended April 30, 2023, respectively, compared to the same periods a year ago, primarily due to the impact of cloud transition agreements, the renewal or extension of subscription services at the fully ramped annual fees after the initial committed term, and new subscription agreements entered into and provisioned since April 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have experienced seasonal variations in our license revenue and, to a lesser extent, in our subscription revenue as a result of increased customer orders in our fourth fiscal quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The success of our sales efforts relies on continued improvements and enhancements to our current services and products, the introduction of new services and products, efficient operation of our cloud infrastructure, continued development of relevant local content and automated tools for updating content, and successful implementations and migrations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Because we pay our services professionals the same amount throughout the year, our gross margins on our services revenue are usually lower in these quarters.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our business and financial results since the third quarter of fiscal year 2020 have been impacted due to these disruptions, which has affected our ARR growth rates, services revenue and margins, operating cash flow and expenses, potentially higher employee attrition, challenges in hiring and onboarding necessary personnel, and the change in fair value of strategic investments.
